hero.title: BUILD AI SYSTEMS
hero.subtitle: Design, connect, and orchestrate AI agents, tools, and business workflows in a node-based canvas. The way humans build software — now applied to AI.

canvas.title: Live Workflow Canvas
canvas.subtitle: Interactive preview — drag, zoom, click nodes

productCanvas.title: The Canvas, Not a Chat Box
productCanvas.subtitle: Your AI workflow is a directed graph of nodes — not a transcript.
productCanvas.point1: Every node is a typed primitive: Trigger, Agent, Tool, Decision, Approval, Output.
productCanvas.point2: Edges are typed too: data flow, control flow, escalation.
productCanvas.point3: Inspect, debug, and version the graph the way you would any production system.

problem.title: PROMPT. CHAT. COPY. PASTE. REPEAT.
problem.subtitle: Most teams are using AI the same way they used Google in 2009: one prompt at a time, no memory, no system.
bullets: Every team member prompts the same model in their own words.
Best results live in private chat history. Nobody else benefits.
Approve, branch, retry, audit — all done by hand.
No version control. No review. No compliance trail.
problem.tagline: A chat thread is not a system.

newParadigm.title: FROM PROMPTS TO SYSTEMS
newParadigm.subtitle: Stop talking to AI. Start designing with it.
newParadigm.footnote: The same AI capability — wrapped in a system humans can own, audit, and improve.

anatomy.title: Eight building blocks. Infinite systems.
anatomy.subtitle: Every workflow in Filament is composed from these typed primitives. Compose them like LEGO. Or like Grasshopper.

descriptions.trigger: Event sources: webhook, schedule, form, email, file upload, manual run.
descriptions.ai: Reasoning nodes: LLMs, agents, classifiers, planners, retrievers.
descriptions.tools: External actions: web search, send email, create ticket, call API.
descriptions.data: Pipelines: fetch, transform, enrich, vectorize, route documents.
descriptions.logic: Control flow: branch, loop, switch, parallel, join, error path.
descriptions.mcp: Model Context Protocol: connect any MCP server — CRM, DB, files, tools.
descriptions.output: Result sinks: response, webhook, database, notification, artifact.

useCases.title: One platform. Every industry.
useCases.subtitle: The same primitives compose into radically different systems.

howItWorks.title: From blank canvas to production system in four moves.

design.label: Design
design.title: Design
design.body: Drag nodes onto the canvas. Set types, parameters, and connections visually.

connect.label: Connect
connect.title: Connect
connect.body: Wire your tools, APIs, MCP servers, data sources, and approval queues.

run.label: Run
run.title: Run
run.body: Execute manually, on a schedule, or via webhook. Inspect every step live.

observe.label: Observe
observe.title: Observe
observe.body: Trace execution, replay runs, audit logs, and refine the graph over time.

architecture.title: AI Agents, connected to everything.
architecture.subtitle: Agents don't work in a vacuum. Filament wires them to the systems where your business already lives.
architecture.agentNote: Reasons, plans, calls tools, transforms data.
architecture.footnote: Every connection is a node. Every node is auditable, versioned, and replaceable.

vision.title: Where Filament is going.
vision.subtitle: Stage 1 is the static site you are reading. The following are roadmap items — not promises, not product yet.

visualWorkflows.title: Visual Workflows
visualWorkflows.body: What you see on this page becomes a real, executable editor.

aiAgents.title: AI Agents
aiAgents.body: Persistent, debuggable agents — not stateless chat threads.

multiAgent.title: Multi-Agent Systems
multiAgent.body: Multiple agents collaborating, negotiating, and handing off work on the same canvas.

enterprise.title: Enterprise Automation
enterprise.body: Org-level governance, RBAC, audit, and approval policies.

os.title: AI Operating System
os.body: A long-term vision: workflows as the primary unit of computing in the AI era.

cta.title: BUILD YOUR AI SYSTEM
cta.subtitle: Stage 1 is a static showcase. Stage 2 will be a working editor. Watch the repo, fork it, or reach out to shape what comes next.
